responsibility: Reviews one verified task contract as a separate lineage through its own input port, recording at most three bounded objection cycles before escalation.
mutation_interface: none — it appends only through cis.assurance.authority's reviewer facade, which owns review_results and objection_cycles
execution_location: in-process, cis-clean application process, as a lineage separate from the author and from the verifier
failure_boundary: fail_closed — a fourth review cycle is refused before any packet is assembled, and so is a review with no recorded verification, a task contract whose independent digest does not recompute, an authorization binding that does not recompute, a task contract linking to a binding that is not the authorization's own, submitted evidence that does not recompute its own digest, a verification digest that does not recompute from its own source fields, and any review ledger that disagrees with the objection-cycle ledger
recovery_behavior: Each cycle is one review append followed by one cycle append, so an interruption leaves a recorded review with no cycle; the next call recomputes the expected cycle index from the ledger and refuses rather than guessing which of the two is current
replacement_contract: A replacement must assemble its packet from authority through its own port, must recompute every digest it relies on instead of accepting a recorded one, must record its lineage on every review, must bound objections to three cycles and escalate on the third, must never read a verification_inputs row as if it were the submission, and must remain unable to reach the verifier or the promotion module through any chain of dependencies
evidence_produced: one review_results row per cycle carrying the packet hash and the digests the reviewer itself recomputed
one objection_cycles row per objecting review, numbered 1 to 3, carrying the recovery decision and recording replacement execution wiring as deferred to the contained-worker capability
a terminal flag on the third cycle, from which the ESCALATED state is derived
an ObjectionCyclesExhausted refusal naming the three recorded cycles when a fourth is attempted
